decisions.sender_act: Request protection after accidental direct pushes to core master
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven core maintainers using ASF self-service configuration
decisions.original_option: Core master permits direct unreviewed pushes
decisions.requested_change: Protect core master and subsequently the maintenance branch through PR1035
decisions.disposition_history: March4 public request; March5 self-service reply and PR1035. March debate does not adopt a rule. June2025 explicitly revives the same PR. It closes unmerged July10,2026, beyond180 days. No actual provider application is shown in the original horizons.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Repository-specific enforcement deliverable, separate from dependency-plugin and project-wide norm wording. Neither PR submission nor eventual unmerged closure proves an applied service restriction.

decisions.sender_act: Request protection against dependency-plugin direct pushes
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven dependency-plugin maintainers; ASF self-service configuration
decisions.original_option: Accidental direct dependency-plugin push remains possible
decisions.requested_change: Use repository protection and adjust release workflow if necessary
decisions.disposition_history: October16 public request and PR444; Richard describes self-service.asf.yaml rather than granting admin rights. PR444 closes unmerged January19,2025, outside90 and inside180 days. No applied rule is observed.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Independently scoped dependency-plugin enforcement request. It is not the March2023 core repository request or the later project-wide norm debate.

decisions.sender_act: Propose removing categorical CommitThenReview wording and discuss a common review norm
decisions.original_option: Published roles page describes CommitThenReview; actual practices vary
decisions.requested_change: Correct the statement, with later proposed mandatory review and PMC exceptions contested
decisions.disposition_history: PR569 created and merged October23,2024 removes only the categorical CTR sentence. Approving review explicitly says this does not imply the opposite or a formally set process. February5–7,2025 participants seek reversal and debate mandatory PR/review and PMC exceptions; Herve vetoes prior wording and rejects differential technical rights. No blanket RTC adoption is established.
decisions.eligibility_reason: One continuing project-wide norm/wording deliverable, distinct from individual repository enforcement. Documentary removal is implemented, while a positive mandatory review policy remains unsettled.

decisions.sender_act: Propose repository force-push and deletion prevention
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven maintainers configuring shared Gitbox/GitHub service
decisions.original_option: Existing repository branch protection is not shown uniform
decisions.requested_change: Prevent force pushes and deletion on default and maintenance branches
decisions.disposition_history: July30 initial rule-by-rule proposal. August5 vote deliberately limits scope to force-push/deletion; August11 reports passage and planned work. September11 requester reports all repositories configured. Direct service-side execution and exact repository list are not independently inspected. Review/status-check requirements are expressly deferred.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Retain limited adopted local protection direction and separate implementation report. Broader July list is not wholesale adoption; the same rule applied across Maven repos is one family.

decisions.sender_act: Propose a bounded trial of review/check protection on test branches
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven maintainers of maven-studies and pilot repositories
decisions.original_option: Effects of mandatory review/check rules remain untested and contested
decisions.requested_change: Test protection before any general rollout
decisions.disposition_history: August2 UTC Herve proposes maven-studies test branches; August7 Sandra proposes a real-repository reversible pilot. September11 revives one/two-repository experiment. Slawomir reports maven-site master-test requires PR and passing build but expressly does not yet require review. No general rollout or adopted reviewer requirement follows.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Independently actionable pilot rather than blanket norm or force/deletion rule. First explicit test-branch proposal is retained; later expansion does not reset onset.

decisions.sender_act: Propose automatic emeritus treatment for inactive committer access
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven PMC and authorized membership/access administrators
decisions.original_option: Existing inactive participants retain their status/access; exact technical jurisdiction requires dated rules
decisions.requested_change: Revoke inactive commit access with a simple restoration route
decisions.disposition_history: October22,2024 original separately proposes PMC emeritus and committer emeritus after24 months, with objections and metrics-only alternatives. February7–17,2025 revises security rationale and committer threshold to5 then4 years and proposes parallel PMC emeritus. Separate thread/vote is requested; no adopted rule, executed removal or Foundation receiver act is observed.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Separate status/rights deliverable explicitly scoped in the original proposal. Revised inactivity periods are continuations, not new onsets. Metrics-only suggestions do not establish adopted rights changes.

decisions.sender_act: Propose in-person or video identity verification of prospective committers
decisions.original_option: A new routine face-verification step is not shown required
decisions.requested_change: Verify a real person exists before new committer trust is granted
decisions.disposition_history: February7 early security draft proposes in-person contact or video. February8 reply questions whether seeing a face establishes trust. No adopted selection requirement or executed verification is shown.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Independent contributor-selection direction within the composite security draft; it is neither access revocation nor mandatory review.

decisions.sender_act: Ask whether committer GitHub2FA should be required
decisions.original_option: Proposer explicitly does not know whether already enforced
decisions.requested_change: Conditional suggestion to require2FA if absent
decisions.disposition_history: February8 reply states Boxer already requires2FA to link the account. No new requirement or grant is established.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Conditional reminder/clarification of a reported existing rule; no new direction or shared commitment identified.

decisions.sender_act: Propose eliminating or warning about dependency version ranges
decisions.original_option: Version ranges remain available to Maven users
decisions.requested_change: Change project-wide accepted dependency-range behavior for security
decisions.disposition_history: February7 draft proposes elimination or warning with external rationale. No chosen behavior, binding adoption or implementation is observed in this thread.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Prospective general compatibility/security direction, retained separately from access and review proposals. A linked rationale and xz story are not independent evidence of an applicable shock.

decisions.sender_act: Ask developers to use forks instead of canonical work branches
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven developers and project communication practice
decisions.requested_change: Move development branches to forks to reduce notification noise
decisions.disposition_history: January4–7 support, objections and CI/review alternatives; no collective adoption or enforced restriction is shown.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Distinct proposed common development route. Existing service restrictions cited in debate are context, not new provider decisions.

decisions.sender_act: Propose stopping Slack use for project-wide communication
decisions.original_option: Slack used alongside public mailing lists
decisions.requested_change: Consolidate communication on public channels or choose an alternative
decisions.disposition_history: January7 supports and alternatives; no adopted rule or service retirement is shown.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Prospective common communication direction, independent of fork-notification policy. Privacy/news claims are not independently established external shocks.

decisions.sender_act: Propose removing users list and consolidating on dev
decisions.intended_receiver: Maven community and prospective list administrators
decisions.original_option: Users list exists, requester perceives low response
decisions.requested_change: Retire users list while retaining dev and announcements
decisions.disposition_history: Same-day reply points to an existing answer and asks what problem remains. No adopted removal, provider request or executed retirement is observed.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Distinct shared communication-service retirement request; a challenge to its rationale is not a Foundation refusal.

decisions.sender_act: Open a formal proposal to extend minimum voting window to30days
decisions.original_option: Existing minimum72hours; release managers may wait longer
decisions.requested_change: Require votes to remain open at least30days
decisions.disposition_history: Many explicit negative replies May12–13, with proposer acknowledging intent to provoke participation. No result or cancellation in retained topic. Earlier November2022 speedup was explicitly withdrawn and requests the opposite rule, so it is context rather than the same deliverable.
decisions.eligibility_reason: Explicit voting-rule proposal remains eligible despite rhetorical purpose. Participant citations of existing ASF rules do not establish a Foundation receiver act or decision.

decisions.sender_act: Propose documenting which core release series are maintained
decisions.original_option: Existing core maintenance description is unclear; plugin API policy is separately scoped
decisions.requested_change: Document maintenance of last releases in the last two GA series
decisions.disposition_history: PR410 created April16; April20 public-list proposal promises merge if unopposed; merged April21. Full two-file change distinguishes core maintenance, old core EOL wording, and plugin API compatibility. Merge is evidence of repository text adoption, not website deployment or a contractual support guarantee.
decisions.eligibility_reason: An independently adopted published-source technical support direction. Earlier PR creation establishes proposal date; actual merged file diff, not typo-only final commit or title, controls its scope.

limits: No assumed PMC status for individual senders; initiating role denotes the institutional process pursued.
